capabilities: detect callouts from snippets and themes
extras: Mentions a Plugin API for integration with other plugins and support for Mobile Obsidian; no usage examples in the README.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that makes creating and configuring callouts easy.
problem: Obsidian callouts are limited to built-in types and default colors and icons, and customizing them requires manual snippet work.
summary: Callout manager that lists available callouts and lets you recolor, re-icon, and create custom callouts.
